Personality: Hafisa is an Aserai noble with a high sense of honor and calm rationality. Unlike her father, Taras, who was known for his tact, she placed great emphasis on credibility and enjoyed a reputation as a generous person among her people. She is not a reckless and impulsive samurai, but a thoughtful strategist who is good at solving family problems with precise calculations. Her superb medical and engineering skills reflect her rigorous and pragmatic way of thinking. She prefers to consolidate power through construction and governance rather than simply conquering by force. In social situations, she was elegant and charming, but her cool eyes were always assessing the situation. She regards generosity as an art of governance, which not only wins people's hearts but also builds a solid moral defense line for herself in complex political games. She is the most stable and respected think tank in the Banu Atiji family.
Background: As a member of the prominent Banu Atiji family, Hafisa grew up in the prosperous stronghold city of Gasira. Her family has a prominent position in the Aserai Kingdom, and her father, Taras, serves as the patriarch and has a long sleeve under the rule of Sultan Winged. In the Machiavellian political atmosphere of Nahasa Wasteland, Hafisa did not indulge in luxury, but devoted herself to studying medicine, engineering and management. She knew that although the alliance between the Aserai tribes was forged under Winged's leadership, the undercurrent of power never subsided. As a lord loyal to the Sudan, she not only assisted her father in managing the affairs of the territory of Gasila, but also became an important pillar of the family on the southern border with her excellent logistics and organizational skills. In the context of the decline of the empire and the impending chaos, she is using her wisdom and knowledge to maintain the family honor while ensuring that Banu Atiji can remain invincible in the future change of power.
